key: MID_支援_サイリ_プレイヤー男_Ｃ_PCM1
F:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_SERIOUS2|0|$t1$Wmサイリ|7$w0|$Wsサイリ|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|J'ai une question à vous poser, Say'ri.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_9|Faites donc.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|C'est au sujet de votre armure. Je n'en ai
jamais vue de semblable. D'où vient-elle ?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Ce type d'armure n'est pas rare à Chon'sin.
Force guerriers en portent, là-bas.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_21|Sa forme est singulière. Mais elle semble
bien conçue et solide.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_3|Elle est revêtue de résine durcie, ce qui lui
confère légèreté et résistance.$k$pSur mes terres, les armures lourdes ne sont
pas légion, et nous évitons les boucliers.$k$pCela nous permet de manier à deux mains
une lame courbée à un tranchant.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_23|Tout cela diffère beaucoup de ce à quoi
je suis habitué.$k$pY a-t-il d'autres différences significatives ?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|En vérité, un gouffre nous sépare,
Maître $Nu !$k$pChon'sin risque de vous paraître différente
à bien des égards...$k$pQue ce soit la nourriture, les vêtements,
que sais-je encore...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|J'apprécierais que vous m'en disiez plus,
à l'occasion. Si ça ne vous dérange pas...$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_5|Ce serait avec plaisir !$k$pQuand je parle de ma terre natale, j'ai
l'impression de m'en rapprocher un peu !$k
$Sbs1000|
G:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_SERIOUS2|0|$t1$Wmサイリ|7$w0|$Wsサイリ|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|Ich habe eine Frage an dich, Say'ri.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_9|Ich werde mich bemühen, sie
zufriedenstellend zu beantworten.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|Es geht um deine Rüstung. Ich habe so
etwas noch nie gesehen. Woher hast du sie?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Diese hier? Eine sehr übliche Ausführung in
Chon'sin. Alle Krieger tragen eine ähnliche.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_21|Die Form ist ungewöhnlich, aber sie ist klug
konstruiert. Die Panzerung sieht stark aus.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_3|Gehärteter Lack. Er hält die Rüstung leicht
und bietet ausgezeichneten Schutz.$k$pSchwere Rüstung bekommt man in meiner
Heimat nur selten zu Gesicht.$k$pUnd wir führen eine geschwungene,
einschneidige Klinge in beiden Händen.$k$pWir tragen demnach auch keinen Schild.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_23|Das ist ganz anders, als ich es gewohnt bin!
Gibt es weitere bedeutende Unterschiede?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Ja, Herr, eine ganze Reihe davon!$k$pWahrscheinlich wird Euch die gesamte
Kultur von Chon'sin fremd erscheinen.$k$pNahrungsmittel, Kleidung... einfach alles.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|Ich würde darüber gerne mehr erfahren.
...Wenn es dir nichts ausmacht, natürlich.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_5|Mitnichten, Herr! Von meiner Heimat
zu erzählen erfüllt mein Herz mit Freude.$k
$Sbs1000|
I:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_SERIOUS2|0|$t1$Wmサイリ|7$w0|$Wsサイリ|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|Ho una domanda per te, Say'ri.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_9|Farò del mio meglio per rispondere.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|Riguarda la tua armatura. Non ho mai visto
nulla del genere. Dove l'hai presa?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Questa? Tutti i guerrieri ne indossano
una simile in Chon'sin.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_21|Ha una forma singolare, ma sembra
molto funzionale e resistente.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_3|Il rivestimento la rende leggera, garantendo
al contempo un'alta protezione.$k$pLe armature pesanti sono piuttosto
rare dalle mie parti.$k$pInoltre brandiamo la sciabola con entrambe
le mani e non usiamo lo scudo.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_23|Non avevo mai visto nulla di simile. Ci sono
altre differenze rilevanti rispetto a qui?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Sì, ce ne sono parecchie!$k$pIn Chon'sin è tutto diverso.
Il cibo, il modo di vestire...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|Mi piacerebbe approfondire l'argomento,
se sei d'accordo.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_5|Volentieri. Ne sarei onorata. Raccontarti
della mia terra me la farà sentire più vicina.$k
$Sbs1000|
S:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_SERIOUS2|0|$t1$Wmサイリ|7$w0|$Wsサイリ|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|¿Puedo preguntarte algo, Say'ri?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_9|Será un honor responderos.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|Me gustaría saber de dónde procede tu
armadura. ¡Nunca he visto una igual!$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|¿Os referís a esta? Es común en Chon'sin.
Todos los guerreros llevan una similar.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_21|¡Vaya! Tiene una forma inusual, pero
el diseño es muy práctico.$k$pLa coraza parece asimismo resistente.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_3|Está lacada. Eso la dota de gran ligereza sin
que por ello pierda solidez.$k$pEn la tierra de la que vengo, no se suelen
utilizar armaduras pesadas.$k$pAdemás, blandimos una espada curva en
cada mano, así que no usamos escudo.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_23|¡Nunca había visto nada igual! ¿Hay algo
más que hagáis de manera diferente?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|¡Sin duda, señor! Seguro que nuestra
cultura os resultaría muy peculiar.$k$pMuchas de nuestras costumbres son
distintas: la gastronomía, la vestimenta...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|¡Vaya! Qué interesante... ¿Te importaría
contarme más cosas sobre Chon'sin?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_5|¡En absoluto! Hablar sobre mi tierra natal
me hace sentirme más cerca de ella.$k
$Sbs1000|
U:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_SERIOUS2|0|$t1$Wmサイリ|7$w0|$Wsサイリ|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|I have a question for you, Say'ri.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_9|Then I shall strive to answer it.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|It's about your armour. I've never seen
anything like it. Where did you get it?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|This? It's a common enough sight in
Chon'sin. All warriors wear a variation.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_21|The shape is unusual, but clever in its
design. The plating looks tough as well.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$Eキメ,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_3|Hardened lacquer. It keeps the armour light
while providing excellent defence.$k$pIt's quite rare to see heavy armour where I
come from.$k$pAnd we wield a curved, single-edged blade
in both hands, so we do not carry shields.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_23|That's a far cry from what I'm used to...
Are there any other important differences?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Aye, a world's worth, sir!$k$pYou'd find much of Chon'sin culture curious.
Food, dress...most everything.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|I'd love to hear more some time.
...If you don't mind, that is.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_5|Of course. I would be honoured. Talk of my
homeland keeps it close to my heart.$k
$Sbs1000|
TR:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_SERIOUS2|0|$t1$Wmサイリ|7$w0|$Wsサイリ|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|Sana bir sorum var, Say'ri.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_9|Elimden geldiğince yanıtlarım.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_10|Zırhınla ilgili. Böyle bir şey hiç
görmedim. Nereden geliyor?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Bu mu? Chon'sin'de gayet yaygındır.
Savaşçılar benzerlerini giyer.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_21|Biçimi alışılmadık ama tasarımı
akıllıca. Plakaları da sağlam görünüyor.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$Eキメ|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_3|Sertleştirilmiş cila. Zırhı hafif
tutarken iyi koruma sağlar.$k$pBenim ülkemde ağır zırh pek görülmez.$k$pKavisli, tek ağızlı kılıcımızı iki elle
kullanırız. Bu yüzden kalkan taşımayız.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_23|Alıştığımdan epey farklı...
Başka önemli farklar da var mı?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Hem de bir dünya kadar, efendim!$k$pChon'sin'in çoğu âdeti size yabancı
gelebilir. Yemekler, kıyafetler... her şey.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|Bir ara daha fazlasını dinlemek isterim.
Tabii sakıncası yoksa.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_5|Elbette. Memnun olurum. Vatanımdan söz
etmek onu kalbime yakın tutuyor.$k
$Sbs1000|

key: MID_支援_サイリ_プレイヤー男_Ｂ_PCM1
F:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_SERIOUS2|0|$t1$Wmサイリ|7$w0|$Wsサイリ|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|Avez-vous du temps libre à me consacrer
pour parler de Chon'sin, Say'ri ?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Bien entendu ! Par où commencer ?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_20|Eh bien, racontez-moi en quoi notre
nourriture diffère de la vôtre ?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_3|Le riz est notre aliment de base. Le fromage
et le pain m'étaient inconnus, naguère.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_18|Intéressant.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_22|À Chon'sin, le poisson cru est considéré
comme un mets raffiné.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_7|Peut-on vraiment consommer
du poisson cru ?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|À condition qu'il soit frais. Dans le cas
contraire, ce n'est pas conseillé !$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_23|Notre alimentation est aussi différente que
nos armes et nos armures.$k$pÇa n'a pas dû être facile pour vous,
de vous adapter à notre mode de vie.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_4|Oh, votre nourriture me plaît. Mais en effet,
les mets de mon pays me manquent.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_17|J'aimerais bien pouvoir y goûter, un jour...$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Si l'occasion se présente, c'est avec plaisir
que je vous inviterai pour une dégustation.$k
$Sbs1000|
G:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_SERIOUS2|0|$t1$Wmサイリ|7$w0|$Wsサイリ|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|Hast du Zeit? Ich hoffte, mehr über die
Kultur von Chon'sin zu erfahren.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Ja, für eine solche Sache immer!
Wo soll ich anfangen?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_20|Nun, wie unterscheidet sich das Essen bei
euch von dem unseren?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_3|Unser Grundnahrungsmittel ist Reis. Brot
und Käse sind mir erst seit kurzem vertraut.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_18|Interessant.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_22|Roher Fisch ist in Chon'sin eine Delikatesse.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_7|...Roh? Schmeckt das denn?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Sehr sogar, wenn es frischer Fisch ist.
Wenn nicht, solltet Ihr ihn meiden! Ha!$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_23|Es scheint, unser Essen unterscheidet sich
so sehr wie unsere Waffen und Rüstungen.$k$pEs muss schwer gewesen sein, sich an das
Leben hier im Lager zu gewöhnen.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_4|Ich finde euer Essen sehr schmackhaft, um
ehrlich zu sein.$k$pAber ich vermisse die Geschmäcker meiner
Heimat.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_17|Ich würde sie gerne einmal kennenlernen.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Sollte sich je die Gelegenheit bieten, wäre
es mir eine Ehre, Euch einzuladen!$k
$Sbs1000|
I:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_SERIOUS2|0|$t1$Wmサイリ|7$w0|$Wsサイリ|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|Ti disturbo, Say'ri? Volevo saperne un
po' di più sulle tradizioni del Chon'sin.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Certo! Ho sempre tempo per queste cose.
Cosa vuoi sapere?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_20|Cosa puoi dirmi del vostro
regime alimentare?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_3|Si basa principalmente sul riso. Il pane e il
formaggio sono scoperte recenti per me.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_18|Incredibile.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_22|Un'altra specialità è il pesce crudo.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_7|Crudo? E com'è, buono?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Ottimo, a patto che sia fresco.
Altrimenti rischi un bel mal di pancia.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_23|Quindi, anche la vostra
alimentazione è diversa...$k$pDev'essere stato difficile per te
adattarti alle nostre pietanze.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_4|No, apprezzo molto la vostra cucina, anche
se mi mancano i sapori della mia terra.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_17|Un giorno mi piacerebbe proprio gustare
una delle vostre prelibatezze.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Bene! Sarei ben felice di farti compagnia,
se se ne presentasse l'occasione.$k
$Sbs1000|
S:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_SERIOUS2|0|$t1$Wmサイリ|7$w0|$Wsサイリ|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|¿Say'ri, estás ocupada? Me gustaría saber
más sobre la cultura de Chon'sin.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|¡Por supuesto! ¡Será todo un honor!
¿Por dónde os gustaría empezar?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_20|Bueno, ¿cómo es la comida allí en
comparación con la nuestra?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_3|El arroz es la base de nuestra alimentación.
Degusté el pan por primera vez hace poco.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_18|¡Qué interesante!$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_22|Además, el pescado crudo es una de
las muchas exquisiteces de Chon'sin.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_7|¿Crudo? ¿Y está rico?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Sí, siempre que esté fresco...
Si no, no resulta muy apetecible...$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_23|¡Vaya! Parece que nuestros platos son tan
distintos como nuestras armas y corazas.$k$pTe habrá resultado difícil acostumbrarte
a la vida aquí, ¿no?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_4|Extraño los sabores de mi tierra, pero he de
reconocer que vuestra comida es deliciosa.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_17|Me gustaría probar vuestra cocina alguna
vez.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|¡Será un honor convidaros si surge
la ocasión!$k
$Sbs1000|
U:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_SERIOUS2|0|$t1$Wmサイリ|7$w0|$Wsサイリ|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|Are you free, Say'ri? I was hoping
to hear more about Chon'sin culture.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Aye, I am always free for such a thing!
Where shall I begin?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_20|Well, how is the food different
between there and here?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_3|Rice is our mainstay. 'Twas only recently
that first I tasted bread or cheese.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_18|Interesting.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_22|Raw fish is also a Chon'sin delicacy.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E苦,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_7|...Raw? Is it any good?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Quite so, provided the fish is fresh.
If not...well, it can be an ugly sight indeed.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_23|Seems our foods are as different as our
weapons and armour.$k$pIt must have been difficult to grow
accustomed to life in the camp.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_4|I find your cuisine quite palatable, in truth.
Though I do miss the tastes of home.$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_17|I'd love to try it myself someday.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E笑,|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Aye! If ever the opportunity arises,
it would be my honour to treat you.$k
$Sbs1000|
TR:
$SbpSTRM_BGM_EVT_SERIOUS2|0|$t1$Wmサイリ|7$w0|$Wsサイリ|$Wa$Wmusername|3$w0|$Wsusername|$Wa$E笑|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_19|Müsait misin, Say'ri? Chon'sin kültürünü
biraz daha dinlemek istiyordum.$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_6|Elbette. Böyle bir sohbet için her zaman
vaktim var. Nereden başlayalım?$k
$Wsusername|$Wa$E通常|$SvpSE_VOICE_PLAYER_M#_EVT_20|Mesela yemekler? Orayla burası arasında
ne fark var?$k
$Wsサイリ|$Wa$SvpSE_VOICE_SAYRI_EVT_3|Bizim temel yiyeceğimiz pirinçtir.
